utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Thanks for joining today! Can you start by telling me about yourself?

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: Sure! I'm a backend engineer with 5 years of experience, mostly building payment systems in Go and Python.

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Tell me about a time you had a conflict with a teammate. How did you handle it?

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: Um, so, there was this one time, we disagreed about the database. I think I was right, so I just kind of did it my way and it worked out.

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: How would you design a rate limiter for a public API?

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: I would use a token bucket per API key stored in Redis with a sliding window as a fallback. We'd also return a retry-after header.

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Why do you want to leave your current company?

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: Honestly, the manager is terrible and the pay is bad.

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Do you have any questions for me?
